summary_retracted: Entry price moved from EUR 9.5 to USD 10
reason: Notion did not change its price. The 11:11:09Z observation was crawled from Germany and quoted EUR; the 11:18:26Z observation was crawled from a GitHub Actions runner in the US and quoted USD. notion.com/pricing selects currency by client IP.
